what_this_is: Canonical names corrected from the property's OWN page, for census identities whose discovered name is a bare chain word or names the same building a different way. The census is not edited: it remains the record of what discovery OBSERVED, and this overlay is what a reader should be shown instead. Every row cites the page that states the replacement, so a correction can be checked or withdrawn by deleting one entry.
authorised_by: PTF-LOUISVILLE-FOUNDER-REVIEW-004 (APPROVE_WITH_CHANGE, canonical_name) and the founder decision recorded in markets/founder_overrides/louisville-ky.json for the Seelbach
rule: A replacement may only be a name the property's own captured page states. Nothing here is invented, and no correction adds or alters a policy fact.
